pr_title: feat(rust, python): improve error message if mmap fails in ipc

issue_context.title: Let `IpcReader.finish` only print warnings if explicitly requested
issue_context.body:
### Problem description

If `IpcReader.finish` stumbles over the error "mmap can only be done on uncompressed IPC files" it immediately prints it to stderr.
https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/184c256b5053b4d167d319f8c9d92e54d1782f52/polars/polars-io/src/ipc/ipc_file.rs#L222

`IpcReader.finish_with_scan_ops` instead takes a `verbose` argument and only prints the error if the `verbose` parameter is set to `true`.
https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/184c256b5053b4d167d319f8c9d92e54d1782f52/polars/polars-io/src/ipc/ipc_file.rs#L159

I wonder if it would make sense for `IpcReader.finish` to show the same behaviour.
comments: You must set `mmap` to false. We should include that in the error message.

> You must set `mmap` to false. We should include that in the error message.
